fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck gate. The property fronts John Hancock Rd with fully open access — Street View (Aug 2025) shows the employee parking lot running directly off the public road with no perimeter fence, no barrier arm, no sliding gate, and no checkpoint pinch-point. Trucks enter the same open driveway and proceed into the truck court / drop yard. Google's Street View car was able to drive onto the interior truck-yard pavement, confirming the entrance is uncontrolled.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at the entrance or on the property. A small dark flat-roofed structure sits deep inside the trailer drop yard (z21 imagery) but it is a fuel-island/maintenance shed in the yard interior, not an entrance guard booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — there is no truck gate at all.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock face along the south side of the main building with many trailers backed in (z18-z19). Counted ~50; band 50+. Exact count uncertain — trailers obscure doors.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large dedicated trailer drop yard south of the dock face — dense rows of drop trailers (75+ visible in imagery); a true standalone trailer-storage lot, band 50+.
fieldNotes.dropYard: True — a dedicated trailer-storage lot occupies the area south of the dock apron, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved truck court between the dock face and the drop yard provides ample interior queue/staging room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The entrance drive plus the deep interior truck court easily holds a queue of 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located in an industrial park on the edge of Taunton MA, a small-to-mid-size city; surrounded by other warehouses with wooded buffers. Edge-of-town small-industrial setting — classified Rural per the rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale visible in overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single PFG building. Other large buildings nearby (NW and SE) are separate occupants of the same industrial park.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property.
